criteria.text: Participants must have histologic or cytological diagnosis of advanced/metastatic Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) with no curative treatment options, and for mixed histology, there must be a predominant histology.

criteria.text: For the phase I trial portion, patients must be treatment naïve or previously treated with chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or targeted therapy for NSCLC; patients who underwent curative intent chemotherapy and/or radiation in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting are allowed to enroll if tumor recurrence occurred greater than 6 months from completion of that therapy; patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy.

source.text: For phase I trial portion, treatment naïve or patients previously treated with chemotherapy, immunotherapy or targeted therapy for NSCLC are allowed. Patient who underwent curative intent chemotherapy and/radiation in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting are allowed to enroll if tumor recurrence occurred greater than 6 months from completion of that therapy (and will be considered treatment naïve in the Stage IV setting). Patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available (i.e, non-resistant EGFR mutations, EGFR T790M mutation, ALK rearrangement, ROS rearrangement, BRAF V600E mutation) are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy.

criteria.text: For the phase II trial portion, Arm A (treatment naïve): Patients must be newly diagnosed and treatment naïve; patients who underwent curative intent chemotherapy and/or radiation in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting are allowed to enroll if tumor recurrence occurred greater than 6 months from completion of therapy; patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy.

source.text:
For phase II trial portion, Patients will be enrolled as two parallel cohorts:

  * A.) Arm A (treatment naïve): Patients who are newly diagnosed and treatment naïve. Patient who underwent curative intent chemotherapy and/radiation in the neoadjuvant or adjuvant setting are allowed to enroll if tumor recurrence occurred greater than 6 months from completion of therapy. Patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available (i.e, non-resistant EGFR mutations, EGFR T790M mutation, ALK rearrangement, ROS rearrangement, BRAF V600E mutation) are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy.

criteria.text: For the phase II trial portion, Arm B (Immunotherapy pre-treated group): Patients must have received prior immunotherapy, and must be primary refractory to immunotherapy or have relapsed disease; patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy.

source.text: B.) Arm B (Immunotherapy pre-treated group): Patients who have received prior immunotherapy. Patients who are primary refractory to immunotherapy (i.e., Patients who were previously treated with immunotherapy and did not at least achieve stable disease on first imaging assessment on immunotherapy) or have relapsed disease (i.e., Patients that were treated with immunotherapy, achieved at least stable disease on first imaging assessment and subsequently developed disease progression or relapse). Patients with NSCLC tumor known to harbor a genomic aberration for which FDA approved treatment is available (i.e, non-resistant EGFR mutations, EGFR T790M mutation, ALK rearrangement, ROS rearrangement, BRAF V600E mutation) are allowed to enroll if they have received prior treatment with the FDA approved targeted therapy

criteria.text: Participants must have AST (SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) less than or equal to 1.5 X institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) or less than or equal to 2.5 X ULN for patients with liver metastases; this will not apply to patients with confirmed Gilbert's syndrome, who will be allowed only in consultation with their physician.
